provenance: Manually authored synthetic vehicle-control examples for offline acceptance. Not a published paper or expert-certified benchmark. Expected labels are evaluation rubrics, not results from a real model.
source: The lateral controller was evaluated in simulation at 20 m/s on a dry road. The peak lateral error was reduced by 12% relative to the PID baseline. The method does not guarantee stability on icy roads. The prediction horizon was 10 steps, with a sampling period of 0.1 s. These results assume an accurate estimate of the tire-road friction coefficient. The longitudinal controller was not evaluated. Figure 3 is referenced, but its image is not part of the provided text.
